title: Altinity SQL Browser Dashboard grafana-grid@2 layout
description: The normative authored Dashboard layout. Grid, Full, and Report are persisted base styles with independent per-tile dimensions. Grid defaults to 6 columns by 2 height units, Full to fixed width 12 by height 2, and Report to centered fixed width 9/12 by height 5. A flow@1 fallback is carried by the Dashboard layout envelope and regenerated from the selected base style.

preset.title: Authored base style
preset.description: The persisted base style. Two- and three-column choices are session previews and are never stored here.

items.title: Per-tile style dimensions
items.description: Independent Grid, Full, and Report dimensions keyed by tile ID. Missing style entries use that style's designed defaults.

grafanaGridHeightV2.title: Tile height
grafanaGridHeightV2.description: Numeric row units from 1 through 16; pixels = 32 + 88 × units.
